youtube.title: She Paid Her Card Every Month. The Balance Never Moved
youtube.description:
Paid on time every month, her card balance never moved. One line on the statement explains the debt trap.

In about three and a half minutes you will see a debt trap explained from the inside: how a minimum payment is split between interest and balance, why new purchases refill what you pay, and how one circled line changes what a person sees. If you were searching for the debt trap explained with a story instead of a spreadsheet, start here.

00:00 Same number
00:24 Every month
00:53 Show me
01:22 The line
01:56 But the balance rose
02:20 The checkout
02:44 Night math
03:06 One circled line

Question for the comments: which line on your statements have you never read?

This is a made-up story and every sum in it is invented.
Voice and visuals in this video are AI-generated. Characters and events are fictional.
